name: Urban Druid
summary: A guardian of streets and settlements who draws power from civilization, resists social influence, and assumes animal forms later than other Druids.

features.name: Urban Nature Bond
features.summary: Choose Charm, Community, Knowledge, Nobility, Protection, Repose, Rune, or Weather as your domain.

features.name: Urban Spontaneous Casting
features.summary: Convert a prepared spell into a spell of the same level or lower from your selected urban domain.

features.name: Lorekeeper
features.summary: Gain Diplomacy and Knowledge (history, local, and nobility) as class skills and a +2 bonus on those checks.

features.name: Resist Temptation
features.summary: Gain +2 on saves against enchantment and divination effects.

features.name: Mental Strength
features.summary: Become immune to charm and compulsion effects.

features.name: A Thousand Faces
features.summary: Alter your appearance at will while in your normal form.
